notes: Store owns one per-collection non-empty clear record containing only removed todos and the prior ID order. Undo merges current survivor values with that batch, preserving IDs, titles, completed states, relative order, additions and edits without resurrecting independent deletions. A later non-empty clear replaces history; empty clear and unavailable undo are safe no-ops.

Model exposes callback-based operations; Controller uses the existing filter/count refresh and View bind/render interfaces. A native Undo clear completed button outside main/footer remains reachable on an empty list and is hidden and disabled when unavailable. Its dedicated row avoids the existing filter/clear controls.

MemoryStorage remains page-local and ID allocation is unchanged. Named collections share the correct undo record, removeAll discards it, and fresh pages have no retained data/history. No cross-refresh persistence, dependency installation, dependency-link change, service start, commit, push, or delegated agent was used.

README documents the behavior, integration owner, test command and built-output verification. The existing build source chain automatically copies src/undo.css; generated dist and dependencies are excluded from changed_files.

Verification limits: jsdom exercises actual app boot, DOM event handlers, accessible button state, computed visibility, filters, counts and backing MemoryStorage; it is not a pixel-layout check in a full browser. The DOM harness skips the unrelated TodoMVC promotional base.js and performs no network requests. Tests use the preinstalled jsdom provided by the trial environment. No material business decision remains unanswered.
